d: The CBI recently filed its chargesheet after completing the investigation in the 2026 NEET paper leak case. We got a copy of the chargesheet, and what we found was crazy. You'd think the stealing happened from the outside, but the investigation showed that the very people entrusted with designing the paper began the leak. How did it happen, how did they manage to get the papers out with so much security, and how did it end up traveling several states before anyone even had an inkling? We delve into CBI's investigation and tell you exactly how the NEET 2026 paper was leaked.
